entries.en: Her short film won a prize at a prestigious festival.
entries.zh: 她的短片在一个享有盛誉的电影节上获了奖。

entries.en: The narrow chair caused some discomfort during the long meeting.
entries.zh: 漫长的会议中，狭窄的椅子让人有些不舒服。

entries.en: The memorial honours the victims of a wartime massacre.
entries.zh: 这座纪念碑悼念一次战时屠杀的遇难者。

entries.zh: 教练吹响哨子，让比赛开始。

entries.zh: 酒店行李员把我们的包提上了台阶。

entries.zh: 晨光中，玫瑰丛上的每个花蕾都又绽开了一些。

entries.zh: 每当天气晴朗，天文俱乐部就会在这里聚会。

entries.zh: 一名志愿者陪同参观者走向主厅。

entries.meaningZh: 疯狂的；极不合理的（非正式）

entries.zh: 花那么多钱买一把坏椅子，似乎太疯狂了。

entries.zh: 只粗略看一眼地图，看不出路线有多难走。

entries.zh: 我们在村外的一片橄榄林里休息。

entries.en: Her offer to help was a gesture of goodwill.
entries.zh: 她主动提出帮助，是一种友善的表示。

entries.en: The workshop explores how actors use bodily movement to tell stories.
entries.zh: 这个工作坊探索演员如何用肢体动作讲故事。

entries.en: She chose ivory rather than white for the curtains.
entries.zh: 她给窗帘选了象牙色，而不是白色。

entries.en: A jazz trio played softly beside the café window.
entries.zh: 一支爵士三重奏乐队在咖啡馆窗边轻声演奏。

entries.en: The longer handle gives the tool more leverage.
entries.zh: 更长的手柄使这件工具获得更大的杠杆力。

entries.zh: 节日前，志愿者清理了海滩沿线的垃圾。

entries.en: The missing costumes threw the rehearsal into turmoil.
entries.zh: 服装不见了，排练因此陷入混乱。

entries.zh: 这本日记记录了一次漫长的跨洋航行。

entries.en: These birds migrate south as the days grow shorter.
entries.zh: 白昼渐短时，这些鸟便向南迁徙。

entries.en: I felt helpless when the computer erased my unfinished drawing.
entries.zh: 电脑清掉了我未完成的画时，我感到很无助。

entries.zh: 这部电影跟拍一个社区筹备古老仪式的过程。

entries.zh: 档案馆用专用盒保护脆弱的信件。

entries.zh: 他抱怨出发太早，却很喜欢这次旅行。

entries.zh: 博物馆展出了十九世纪使用的火炮。

entries.zh: 音乐的选择成了争论的焦点。

entries.zh: 小说以一场反抗残暴国王的叛乱开篇。

entries.en: She took his careless comment as an insult.
entries.zh: 她把他那句随意的评论当成了侮辱。

entries.zh: 这部小说的主角患有哮喘。

entries.en: Keep the cardboard figures upright while the glue dries.
entries.zh: 胶水干透前，让纸板人偶保持直立。

entries.zh: 一颗珍珠垂在精巧的银链上。

entries.zh: 孩子们在海事博物馆参观了一艘退役潜艇。

entries.en: The apple trees bloom a little later on this hillside.
entries.zh: 这片山坡上的苹果树开花稍晚些。

entries.zh: 一个金属支架把旧架子固定在墙上。

entries.en: The perfume of orange blossoms drifted through the window.
entries.zh: 橙花的香气飘进了窗户。

entries.en: The art group published a manifesto explaining its aims.
entries.zh: 这个艺术团体发表宣言，阐明了自己的目标。

entries.en: A friendly rivalry developed between the two school choirs.
entries.zh: 两所学校的合唱团之间形成了友好的竞争。

entries.zh: 连续几次失利后，球队情绪不稳定，教练难以应对。

entries.zh: 博物馆对每位新导游都进行严格培训。

entries.zh: 找到合适的排练室是我们的第一道难关。

entries.zh: 演员的红披风扫过了舞台。

entries.zh: 一队老式巴士驶进了村广场。

entries.en: Her book is considered the definitive history of the theatre.
entries.zh: 她的书被认为是这家剧院最权威的历史著作。

entries.en: The drama follows a young barrister working in London.
entries.zh: 这部剧讲述一位在伦敦工作的年轻出庭律师。

entries.en: The gardener photographed a tiny pest on the cabbage leaves.
entries.zh: 园丁拍下了卷心菜叶上的一只小害虫。

entries.en: She added a scoop of ice cream to the warm pie.
entries.zh: 她在热派上加了一勺冰激凌。

entries.en: The ducks splashed water onto the edge of the path.
entries.zh: 鸭子把水溅到了小路边缘。

entries.en: Our team won by three goals to nil.
entries.zh: 我们队以三比零获胜。

entries.en: A green caterpillar climbed the stalk of a sunflower.
entries.zh: 一条绿色毛毛虫爬上了向日葵的茎。

entries.en: The enormous stage did not intimidate the young singer.
entries.zh: 巨大的舞台没有让这位年轻歌手胆怯。

entries.en: The ancient vase shows a goddess beside an owl.
entries.zh: 这只古瓶上画着一位女神，旁边有只猫头鹰。

entries.en: The old shed was on the verge of collapse.
entries.zh: 那间旧棚屋已经濒临倒塌。

entries.en: Technical faults plagued the opening night of the show.
entries.zh: 技术故障不断困扰着演出的首演之夜。

entries.zh: 我的借书证本月底到期。

entries.zh: 洪水对河边的村庄是一场灾难。

entries.zh: 小票附有一张供我们下次使用的优惠券。

entries.en: The organizer withheld the winner's name until the final announcement.
entries.zh: 组织者一直保密获胜者的名字，直到最后宣布。

entries.en: The weather in these hills is notoriously unpredictable.
entries.zh: 这些山里的天气出了名地难以预测。

entries.en: The new glass tower stood in stark contrast to the cottages.
entries.zh: 新玻璃塔楼与那些小屋形成了鲜明对比。

entries.en: Restoring antique clocks became a lucrative business for him.
entries.zh: 修复古董钟表成了他一项收入丰厚的生意。

entries.en: The fabric is resistant to stains and easy to clean.
entries.zh: 这种布料耐污，容易清洁。

entries.en: Her violin case has travelled further than any of her suitcases.
entries.zh: 她的小提琴盒比她任何一只行李箱去过的地方都远。

entries.en: The young swimmer is a serious contender for the title.
entries.zh: 这位年轻泳将是冠军的有力争夺者。

entries.en: He wore a bright orange vest over his jacket.
entries.zh: 他在夹克外套了一件亮橙色背心。

entries.en: I called to inquire about spaces in the evening class.
entries.zh: 我打电话询问晚课是否还有名额。

entries.en: A marble bust of the poet stands near the entrance.
entries.zh: 入口附近立着那位诗人的大理石半身像。

entries.en: The early goal bolstered the team's confidence.
entries.zh: 开场不久的进球增强了球队的信心。

entries.en: The journalism course includes a discussion of libel.
entries.zh: 这门新闻课程包括对书面诽谤的讨论。

entries.en: The chocolate egg was wrapped in shiny purple foil.
entries.zh: 巧克力蛋包着闪亮的紫色金属箔。

entries.meaningZh: 生动热烈的；兴致勃勃的

entries.zh: 电影放映后，大家展开了热烈讨论。

entries.en: The trip deepened my interest in the history of navigation.
entries.zh: 这次旅行加深了我对航海史的兴趣。

entries.en: The museum label explains why the mineral is radioactive.
entries.zh: 博物馆的说明牌解释了这种矿物为何具有放射性。

entries.zh: 俱乐部引入预约制度，以控制过度拥挤。

entries.en: The detective novel mentions a suspect released on bail.
entries.zh: 这部侦探小说提到了一名获保释的嫌疑人。

entries.en: She conquered her fear of heights on the climbing wall.
entries.zh: 她在攀岩墙上克服了恐高。

entries.zh: 老师就排练时间调解了两个小组之间的分歧。

entries.en: The play portrays a dictator who fears even his own shadow.
entries.zh: 这部戏描绘了一个连自己的影子都害怕的独裁者。

entries.zh: 艺术家用几张老照片制作了一幅合成图像。

entries.en: The children giggled when the puppet lost its hat.
entries.zh: 木偶的帽子掉了，孩子们咯咯笑起来。

entries.en: The weary hikers welcomed the sight of the village inn.
entries.zh: 疲惫的徒步者看到村里的旅店，十分欣喜。

entries.en: The comedy features a millionaire who cannot cook an egg.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧里有一位连鸡蛋都不会煮的百万富翁。

entries.en: Empty seats were scarce by the time we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们到达时，空座已经很少了。

entries.en: The concert raised money for several charitable organizations.
entries.zh: 这场音乐会为几个慈善组织筹集了资金。

entries.en: The translator carefully preserved the humour of the original story.
entries.zh: 译者细心保留了原故事的幽默。

entries.en: The new bookshelf displaced a chair in the corner.
entries.zh: 新书架取代了角落里一把椅子的位置。

entries.en: She hopes to design lightweight materials for aerospace engineering.
entries.zh: 她希望为航空航天工程设计轻质材料。

entries.en: The universities signed a bilateral agreement on student exchanges.
entries.zh: 两所大学签署了学生交换的双边协议。

entries.en: My request for a larger rehearsal room is still pending.
entries.zh: 我申请更大排练室的请求仍在等待处理。

entries.en: Winter storms slowly eroded the cliff beneath the lighthouse.
entries.zh: 冬季风暴慢慢侵蚀着灯塔下的悬崖。

entries.en: She hummed a familiar tune while washing the cups.
entries.zh: 她洗杯子时哼着一首熟悉的曲子。

entries.en: The director attended the premiere with the young cast.
entries.zh: 导演与年轻演员们一起出席了首映式。

entries.en: The museum's display includes empty ammunition boxes from the period.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展品包括那个时期的空弹药箱。

entries.en: A shaft of sunlight pierced the dark clouds.
entries.zh: 一束阳光穿透了乌云。

entries.en: The exhibition includes a hybrid vehicle with a transparent engine cover.
entries.zh: 展览中有一辆装着透明发动机罩的混合动力汽车。

entries.zh: 被遗忘的午餐盒里传出一股恶臭。

entries.zh: 报纸以连载形式刊登了这个故事。

entries.en: She looked dubious when I described my ambitious timetable.
entries.zh: 我描述那份雄心勃勃的时间表时，她看起来心存疑虑。

entries.en: The new ending required drastic changes to the script.
entries.zh: 新结局需要大幅修改剧本。

entries.en: The statue depicts a muscular athlete holding a discus.
entries.zh: 这座雕像描绘了一位手持铁饼、肌肉发达的运动员。

entries.en: Her compliment about my drawing encouraged me to keep practising.
entries.zh: 她对我画作的赞美鼓励我继续练习。

entries.en: He commutes by train and reads during the journey.
entries.zh: 他坐火车通勤，并在路上看书。

entries.en: The article traces the demise of the town's last cinema.
entries.zh: 这篇文章追溯了镇上最后一家电影院的消亡。

entries.en: The supporters chanted their team's name throughout the match.
entries.zh: 球迷们整场比赛都在有节奏地喊球队的名字。

entries.en: We dismantled the tent before the wind grew stronger.
entries.zh: 风变大之前，我们拆了帐篷。

entries.en: The children sowed sunflower seeds along the fence.
entries.zh: 孩子们沿着篱笆播下了向日葵种子。

entries.en: A quiet table is preferable to one near the speakers.
entries.zh: 安静的桌子比靠近音箱的桌子更合适。

entries.en: The documentary drew attention to the plight of abandoned animals.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片引起了人们对被遗弃动物困境的关注。

entries.en: The farmer ploughed the field before the first frost.
entries.zh: 农民在初霜到来前犁了地。

entries.en: My first attempt at juggling was rather pathetic.
entries.zh: 我第一次尝试杂耍，相当差劲。

entries.en: An accidental splash of paint improved the picture.
entries.zh: 意外溅上的一抹颜料反而让画更好看了。

entries.en: The staff evacuated the hall during the fire drill.
entries.zh: 消防演习时，工作人员疏散了大厅里的人。

entries.en: At low tide, the wreck of an old boat became visible.
entries.zh: 退潮时，一艘旧船的残骸显露了出来。

entries.en: The heavy books squashed the paper flowers in my bag.
entries.zh: 沉重的书把我包里的纸花压扁了。

entries.en: The exhibition documents a famine through letters and photographs.
entries.zh: 展览通过书信和照片记录了一场饥荒。

entries.en: The extra weight revealed the instability of the makeshift table.
entries.zh: 增加的重量暴露出那张临时桌子不稳固。

entries.en: I was completely ignorant of the town's musical traditions.
entries.zh: 我对这个镇的音乐传统一无所知。

entries.en: The local club chose to affiliate with a national association.
entries.zh: 这个本地俱乐部选择加入一个全国协会。

entries.en: We dodged puddles on the way to the station.
entries.zh: 去车站的路上，我们一路躲着水坑。

entries.meaningZh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

entries.zh: 一位精力充沛的志愿者带孩子们做热身游戏。

entries.en: The little attic room felt cosy on rainy evenings.
entries.zh: 下雨的夜晚，那间小阁楼显得温暖舒适。

entries.en: My grandfather taught me chess using a wooden set.
entries.zh: 祖父用一副木制棋具教我下国际象棋。

entries.en: Restoring the garden became a shared endeavour among neighbours.
entries.zh: 修复花园成了邻居们共同努力的事情。

entries.en: The editor suggested a wholesale revision of the opening chapter.
entries.zh: 编辑建议全面修改第一章。

entries.en: A sinister shadow moved across the wall in the film.
entries.zh: 电影里，一个阴森的影子掠过墙壁。

entries.en: The bookshop received a shipment of new atlases this morning.
entries.zh: 书店今早收到了一批新地图册。

entries.en: We gathered at the station to say farewell to our teacher.
entries.zh: 我们聚在车站，向老师告别。

entries.en: The rider held the reins loosely as the horse walked.
entries.zh: 马缓步行走时，骑手松松地握着缰绳。

entries.en: A large cabbage filled the bottom of her shopping basket.
entries.zh: 一个大卷心菜占满了她购物篮的底部。

entries.zh: 那个吓人的影子其实只是外面一根无害的树枝。

entries.en: The hallway was gloomy until someone opened the curtains.
entries.zh: 有人拉开窗帘后，昏暗的走廊才亮起来。

entries.zh: 故事在一场海上风暴中达到高潮。

entries.en: It would be selfish to keep all the biscuits for myself.
entries.zh: 把所有饼干都留给自己就太自私了。

entries.en: In the adventure story, pirates kidnap a young cartographer.
entries.zh: 在这个冒险故事中，海盗绑架了一位年轻制图师。

entries.en: The clay hardened overnight beside the open window.
entries.zh: 陶土在敞开的窗边放了一夜后变硬了。

entries.en: Her description of the house as a maze was apt.
entries.zh: 她把这所房子形容为迷宫，十分贴切。

entries.en: His earnest apology helped end the argument.
entries.zh: 他诚恳的道歉帮助平息了争吵。

entries.en: The athlete hurled the discus across the field.
entries.zh: 运动员把铁饼奋力掷向场地远处。

entries.en: She tried to hide her irritation at the repeated interruptions.
entries.zh: 她试图掩饰对接连打断的恼怒。

entries.en: Rice is a staple in many of the meals she cooks.
entries.zh: 她做的许多餐食都以米饭为主食。

entries.en: The musician's autobiography begins with his first piano lesson.
entries.zh: 这位音乐家的自传从他的第一堂钢琴课写起。

entries.en: The handmade bowls had charmingly irregular edges.
entries.zh: 这些手工碗的边缘不规则，却很有韵味。

entries.zh: 林间小路旁躺着一截空心木头。

entries.zh: 因为只来三位客人，我们把食谱中的用量减半了。

entries.zh: 这个袋子用粗糙的棕色纤维织成。

entries.zh: 连绵不断的雨让我们整个周末都待在室内。

entries.zh: 我一拿起那块饼干，它就碎了。

entries.zh: 孩子们等得不耐烦，不停地问火车什么时候到。

entries.meaningZh: 东方风格的（用于物品或艺术）

entries.zh: 房间里铺着一张旧式东方风格地毯。

entries.zh: 第一批燕子预示着春天的到来。

entries.zh: 那把钝剪刀几乎剪不动包装纸。

entries.zh: 几只羊在山坡上安静地吃草。

entries.zh: 合唱团上电视表演后，成员人数增至原来的三倍。

entries.zh: 这门轻松的陶艺课欢迎毫无基础的初学者。

entries.zh: 请在表上填写完整的邮寄地址。

entries.zh: 等候太久，孩子们开始坐立不安。

entries.zh: 市政部门铺设了图书馆和公园之间的小路。

entries.zh: 身为航海新手，我觉得每种绳结都很难懂。

entries.zh: 发牌之前把牌充分洗匀。

entries.zh: 这本地图册标出了各个主权国家的边界。

entries.en: Dust had collected in the narrow groove along the frame.
entries.zh: 框架沿边的细槽里积了灰。

entries.en: An old cannon points towards the sea from the fort.
entries.zh: 堡垒里的一门旧炮朝着大海。

entries.en: Her strong work ethic impressed everyone in the workshop.
entries.zh: 她勤勉的工作作风给工坊里的每个人留下了深刻印象。

entries.en: Please do not embarrass him by mentioning the broken vase.
entries.zh: 请别提那只打碎的花瓶，让他难堪。

entries.en: Loose fishing line can endanger birds around the lake.
entries.zh: 散落的钓鱼线会危及湖边的鸟。

entries.en: The dental clinic moved to a brighter building last year.
entries.zh: 那家牙科诊所去年搬进了一栋更明亮的楼。

entries.en: Finishing the huge mural in one week was an impressive feat.
entries.zh: 一周内画完这幅巨型壁画，是一项了不起的成就。

entries.en: These hardy shrubs survive the cold winters on the coast.
entries.zh: 这些耐寒灌木能熬过海岸寒冷的冬天。

entries.en: Fresh mortar filled the gaps between the old bricks.
entries.zh: 新砂浆填满了旧砖之间的缝隙。

entries.en: We climbed the steps to the ruined fort above the harbour.
entries.zh: 我们沿台阶登上了港口上方的堡垒遗址。

entries.en: The ball hit the wall with a loud smack.
entries.zh: 球啪的一声重重撞在墙上。

entries.en: The pirate in the picture has a parrot on his shoulder.
entries.zh: 图中的海盗肩上站着一只鹦鹉。

entries.en: The booking form includes a question about food allergies.
entries.zh: 预订表上有一个关于食物过敏的问题。

entries.en: She poured the pancake batter into the hot pan.
entries.zh: 她把煎饼面糊倒进热锅。

entries.en: A squirrel darted across the path ahead of us.
entries.zh: 一只松鼠飞快地窜过我们前面的小路。

entries.en: Drops of candle wax hardened on the wooden tray.
entries.zh: 滴下的烛蜡在木托盘上凝固了。

entries.en: The history exhibit describes a levy once charged on imported cloth.
entries.zh: 历史展览介绍了一项曾对进口布料征收的税费。

entries.en: The museum preserves the diary of a battalion commander.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存着一位营长的日记。

entries.en: The arts fund subsidizes tickets for local school groups.
entries.zh: 艺术基金为当地学校团体补贴门票。

entries.en: The library's endowment supports the restoration of rare books.
entries.zh: 图书馆的捐赠基金支持珍本书的修复。

entries.en: The old travel diary lists every expense in francs.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日记以法郎记下了每笔花费。

entries.en: The glue left a clear mark on the cardboard.
entries.zh: 胶水在纸板上留下了一个透明印迹。

entries.en: A yellow chick followed the hen around the yard.
entries.zh: 一只黄色小鸡跟着母鸡在院子里走。

entries.en: Our teacher vetoed the idea of rehearsing on the roof.
entries.zh: 老师否决了去屋顶排练的主意。

entries.en: She discovered her interest in archaeology during a museum visit.
entries.zh: 参观博物馆时，她发现自己对考古学很感兴趣。

entries.en: Losing the rehearsal room was a setback, but we found another.
entries.zh: 失去排练室是一次挫折，不过我们又找到了一个。

entries.en: Patience is a cardinal virtue when teaching beginners.
entries.zh: 教初学者时，耐心是一项基本美德。

entries.en: The surprise goal unleashed a roar from the crowd.
entries.zh: 那个出人意料的进球引发了人群的欢呼。

entries.en: We could see the offshore wind turbines from the beach.
entries.zh: 我们从海滩上能看到近海的风力涡轮机。

entries.en: We dined on the terrace as the sun went down.
entries.zh: 太阳落山时，我们在露台上用餐。

entries.en: The bookshop dispatched my order the following morning.
entries.zh: 书店第二天早上发出了我的订单。

entries.en: The grey mare stood beside her foal in the field.
entries.zh: 那匹灰色母马站在田野里，身旁是她的小马驹。

entries.en: The ducklings hatched just as the children arrived at the farm.
entries.zh: 孩子们刚到农场，小鸭子就破壳了。

entries.en: A red lipstick lay beside the actor's makeup mirror.
entries.zh: 演员的化妆镜旁放着一支红色口红。

entries.en: The biography mentions the artist's struggle with arthritis.
entries.zh: 这本传记提到了那位艺术家与关节炎抗争的经历。

entries.en: Each iron spike along the fence was painted black.
entries.zh: 篱笆上的每根铁尖刺都漆成了黑色。
